<div class="card-body">
'''R1-G4 (Arone-Geefour)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].







<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">R1-G4（アーワン・ジーフォー）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">大型艦に乗っているなら、戦闘力と航行速度に＋１する。また、その宇宙船は耐：損耗＜３を得る。大きすぎて宇宙戦闘機には乗せられない。</span>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">普及した旧式操縦ドロイドで、今でも大型の宇宙船や貨物船で使用されている。マークII・リアクター・ドローンの外殻に身を包む。所有者が捕えられ、R1-G4は廃棄された。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' R1-G4 (Arone-Geefour).

'''Card text:''' If aboard a capital ship, adds 1 to power and travel speed. That starship also gains immunity to attrition < 3. Too large to be placed aboard a starfighter.

'''Lore:''' A widespread older-model piloting droid still used on large starships and freighters. Encased in the shell of a Mark II reactor drone. R1-G4 was discarded after its owner was captured.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore describes an older piloting droid used on large starships and freighters; the English describes an old-model astromech used on capital starships and large freighters. The Japanese refers to the reactor drone's shell; the English describes it as armored.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[R1-G4 (Arone-Geefour)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
